If cos(theta) > 0, v1 and v2 are in the same hemisphere. If cos(theta) < 0, v1 and v2 are not in the same hemisphere. The second case occurs when the light is "under the surface point" that we're trying to shade. So we max(dot(v1,v2), 0.0f) so we don't add light to such a point which the light can't reach.
